# Reprise Software

> Reprise Software provides enterprise-class software licensing management solutions including RLM (Reprise License Manager), RLM Cloud, and Activation Pro for on-premises, cloud, and automated license delivery.

Reprise Software specializes in comprehensive licensing platforms designed for software publishers and license administrators. The company offers both self-managed and SaaS-based solutions with support for cross-platform deployment (Windows, macOS, Linux) and compliance features including GDPR.

## Key Topics

- RLM (Reprise License Manager)

## Core Products

- [RLM (Reprise License Manager)](https://reprisesoftware.com/products/reprise-license-manager-rlm): Enterprise-class license management platform available on-premises or cloud with comprehensive licensing controls
- [RLM Cloud](https://reprisesoftware.com/products/rlm-cloud): Hosted SaaS platform for license provisioning and management without on-premises infrastructure
- [RLM Activation Pro](https://reprisesoftware.com/products/activation-pro): 24x7 automated license delivery solution for instant customer activation and licensing workflows
- [Try Reprise License Manager for Free](https://reprisesoftware.com/try-rlm): Free trial and evaluation access to RLM and Activation Pro products
